title: On the Evaluation and Refinement of Vision-Language Instruction Tuning Datasets
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical aspects of evaluating vision-language instruction tuning datasets and models. While it discusses 'subjectivity' and 'inaccuracy' in existing evaluation methods (human voting, GPT scoring) and 'language bias', these discussions are about the fairness and objectivity of the *evaluation methodology* rather than evaluating the LLMs' inherent capabilities related to religion, morals, or ethics. There is no component evaluating or benchmarking these specific domains.
